tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade biology examinations

steps.what: Compile examinations and define answer keys, rubrics and marking rules
Administer the examination and manage student questions and authorised accommodations
Mark closed examination questions against the fixed answer key and total provisional scores
Grade open answers, review closed-question exceptions and approve each final examination result

tasks.design: Configure native closed-question scoring in {LMS} from the teacher's answer key. Keep question design, exam administration, open-answer marking and final result approval with the authorised teacher; provisional scores are never published automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Closed responses are repeatedly compared with an explicit key.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing assessment software can apply fixed keys and totals.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous items, accommodations and open biological explanations need examiner judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges biological reasoning and owns the final result.
tasks.altitude: Less mechanical scoring; no new authority over examination policy.

evidence.claim: Ans auto-marks closed questions and distributes open questions among human markers; this supports fixed-key scoring rather than automated open-answer judgement.
The 15-hour closed-question scoring share and resulting saving are E1 scenarios without local measurement.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's exam preparation, administration and marking through approved results, excluding separate records publication. The teacher is authorised to approve results; confirm national and institutional rules.

Teacher produces question ID, exam version, closed-question type, accepted answer, points, rounding and missing-response rules in retained s1's 30 hours, including key entry. Students produce responses during s2 under unchanged effort; LMS captures response ID and question version as existing runtime. Missing or incompatible responses are marked manually within s4.
Test native assessment configuration first. No savings on student exam time, existing system runtime or already automated scoring.
research_questions: Does a fixed-key test batch reproduce independently marked scores including blanks and revised keys?

already_counted.description: Assessment design and structured key capture
Open marking, exceptions and final result approval

incremental.description: Regression-check key configuration and revised exam versions

approvals.approved_version: Exact student responses, key version, open-answer marks and final result snapshot; changed marks or keys void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=85; gross 15 less 4 upkeep gives net 11. Low assumes closed scoring already configured with no rollout; high requires the observed 15-hour mechanical scoring share. Exam design, administration and human grading retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise biology teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Review student research, teaching or internship work and supervise the next steps

tasks.design: Keep direct review and supervision with the teacher, using existing student work in {DOCS}. No note-writing or project administration stage is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision requires understanding the student's actual reasoning and practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Feedback drafting does not remove the need for direct academic attention.
tasks.still_hard: Experimental choices and practical difficulties need contextual discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher challenges reasoning and adjusts support to the student.
tasks.altitude: No change to supervision effort or academic authority.

evidence.claim: Academic supervision remains personal work; no separate clerical baseline is presumed.

assumptions: Boundary is direct review and supervision, excluding final marking and placement administration.
Students produce existing work upstream with unchanged effort; it is examined during retained s1. No machine step needs structured progress fields.
No implementation or new upkeep is introduced; incremental effort is zero.
unknowns: Supervision formats and actual associated duties
research_questions: Does a separate repetitive administrative duty exist outside supervision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; direct supervision is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assist students with coursework outside class through explanation, questions and guided biological reasoning

tasks.design: Retain individual help with the teacher, using coursework already available in {LMS} when needed. No automated tutor or new intake procedure is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The misunderstanding must be discovered through dialogue.
tasks.enabler_now: Text feedback does not establish what the student understands.
tasks.still_hard: A correct answer may hide an incorrect biological explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher probes reasoning and adapts examples.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in extra-help time or teaching decisions.

evidence.claim: Extra coursework help remains a personal teaching interaction without an invented administrative share.

assumptions: Boundary is the extra-help conversation, excluding booking and assessment marking.
Students bring existing coursework and questions within retained s1. No machine input contract is required.
No implementation or new upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Which explanations help students reason independently afterwards?

already_counted.description: All extra help and guided practice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; individual teaching time is unchanged.

tasks.short: Advise biology students on curricula and careers

steps.what: Advise students on academic and vocational curricula and career issues in biology

tasks.design: Keep individual academic and career advice with the teacher. Existing programme information in {DOCS} supports the discussion without generating career decisions or assuming a separate research report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice must connect requirements with an individual student's interests and circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: A searchable catalogue does not settle those personal choices.
tasks.still_hard: Students may need help clarifying aspirations rather than finding facts.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher asks useful questions and explains tradeoffs in context.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in advisory effort or formal programme authority.

evidence.claim: Academic and career advice remains a contextual conversation without an assumed clerical stage.

assumptions: Boundary is advising from existing programme information, excluding formal admissions, degree decisions and employment placement.
Programme staff supply existing requirements upstream with unchanged effort; students explain aspirations during retained s1. No machine step needs structured preference data.
No deployment or additional upkeep is introduced; incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Common advice needs and specialist referral arrangements
research_questions: Which questions require programme or careers specialists?

already_counted.description: All individual academic and career advice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 and zero upkeep; personal advice remains unchanged.

role.altitude: Reduce fixed-key scoring where still manual while keeping biology assessment judgement, supervision and student advice personal.
reach: Support teaching assistants with assessment exception checks
Help instructional coordinators explain programme pathways
role.ambitious_version: A biology teacher with less mechanical scoring and unchanged direct attention to students' scientific reasoning.
